journal_lines: Good stand of oak. Clean work.
The oak at the center is old enough to matter.
Birch light is different. White bark scatters everything.
Clean, quick work. These trees have nothing to say about it.
The oak was hollow at center but the outer rings were sound.
A cluster of three birch together. Took the oldest.
The forest floor here is root-packed. Finding footing took adjustment.
Straight grain oak. These grew without crowding.
The fallen oak was recoverable. Took the useful sections.
Birch at the forest edge grows faster. The grain shows it.
Old canopy here. The light below almost green.
Two oaks leaning toward each other. Took one.
Found where the forest thins. The timber there grows harder.
A bird's nest in the oak I was working. Finished carefully around it.
The birch groves sound different from inside. Rustling and pale light.
